feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the Feedback Form at the OCENR frontline desk and drop it in the drop box, or hand it to the Officer of the Day. You can also call 0946-599-0597.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The Administrative Division checks what the feedback is about within one working day and passes it to the division concerned. Once that division replies, the office contacts you by email, text or phone. Complaints go on the Complaint Form (CSC Form No. 3) or by email, and need your full name, address and contact details, an account of what happened, any evidence, and the name of the person being complained about. The Administrative Division reads complaints daily, coordinates with the division concerned, investigates where needed, then writes an Incident Report for the Legal Office. The Legal Office sends its findings to the City Mayor, copy to OCENR, for final action.

services.title: Getting a Permit to Dump at the city disposal facility
services.description: Permission for an individual or a firm to bring garbage directly to the city's designated disposal facility, granted case by case. Ordinary household waste is collected from each barangay's Materials Recovery Facility or Drop-Off Center instead, under the city's timed and scheduled segregated collection and its "No Segregation, No Collection" policy.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources (OCENR)

requirements.item: Letter of request, 1 original and 1 photocopy
Duly filled-out Permit to Dump Form

steps.client: Submit the letter of request to the Desk Officer one week before the scheduled date. (OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The Desk Officer reviews the request and issues the Permit to Dump Form.

steps.client: Fill out the Permit to Dump Form. (OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The Desk Officer reviews the accomplished form and checks that all fields are properly filled out.

steps.client: Allow inspection of the garbage for disposal. (Disposal site or the client's location)
steps.agency: Technical personnel conduct an ocular inspection of the garbage subject for disposal.

steps.client: Wait for the inspection report and recommendation. (OCENR Technical Office)
steps.agency: Administrative personnel prepare the inspection report and recommendation for approval.

steps.client: Claim the Permit to Dump, or receive the explanation if the request is declined. (OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The City ENRO issues the Permit to Dump if the request is approved.
The City ENRO explains the reason for disapproval if the request is declined.

notes: The one-hour ocular inspection depends on where the waste is; the charter says so on the step itself.
verifyNotes: The charter's last step lists two agency actions, one for an approved request and one for a declined request, and its own TOTAL counts both. They are recorded as two steps here so the derived total reconciles with the charter's 1 Hour and 35 Minutes. Confirm against the PDF that both were intended to be counted.

services.title: Environmental Certificate by online seminar, for a lapsed or missing record
services.description: The Environmental Certificate a business needs before a permit to operate is issued, taken through the online seminar over Zoom. This is the route for establishments whose Certificate of Attendance has expired and for those with no record of attending the Ecological Solid Waste Management seminar at all. City Ordinance No. 0010-2008 requires every business and commercial establishment to sit the seminar.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources (OCENR)

requirements.item: Accomplished Environmental Baseline Data Sheet, filled out through Google Forms
requirements.whereToSecure: Link on OCENR's official Facebook page

requirements.item: Attendance at the virtual Environmental Webinar
requirements.whereToSecure: OCENR sends the Zoom link to the applicant's email address

steps.client: Accomplish the Environmental Baseline Data Sheet through Google Forms.
steps.agency: OCENR reviews the form and sends the virtual seminar details over Zoom to the applicant's email address. Applicants with an expired Certificate of Attendance are cleared from the negative list once the Environmental Baseline Data Sheet is submitted; applicants tagged as non-compliant are cleared once they attend the virtual seminar.
steps.feeText: 50.00. For a business establishment with a Mayor's Permit, payment is included in the one-time assessment.

steps.client: Attend the Environmental Webinar. (Online, over Zoom)
steps.agency: OCENR conducts the Environmental Webinar.
OCENR prepares and prints the Environmental Certificate after the webinar for release to the client, and sends an electronic copy by email on request.

notes: The seminar runs five afternoons a week, Monday to Friday, during the January to March business permit renewal peak, and twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons from April to December.
An Environmental Certificate is valid for three years. After that a business renews it by attending the seminar again.
verifyNotes: The 50.00 fee cell also carries the note about the one-time assessment; check the PDF for whether any other amount applies to establishments without a Mayor's Permit.

services.title: Getting a Certificate of No Objection to cut a tree
services.description: The city's certificate saying it does not object to trees being cut. It is not the permit itself: the Permit to Cut Tree is issued by the DENR, and the DENR requires this certification from the LGU as one of its requirements. Go to DENR-PENRO Albay first for their checklist, then come here.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources (OCENR)

requirements.item: Letter of request addressed to the City Mayor, attention the City ENRO, giving the mobile number of the person who will coordinate the ocular site visit. Two original copies.
Barangay Certificate of No Objection to Cut Trees
Land title or tax declaration, for a private lot
Map or diagram showing the trees to be cut
Individual pictures of the trees to be cut, with their geographical coordinates
Inventory list of the trees to be cut
Site development plan showing the details of the project
Authorization letter from the landowner, if the requesting party is not the property owner
Identification card of the landowner or transacting party
Barangay resolution or minutes of the barangay consultation meeting, for selected government projects
Environmental Compliance Certificate or Certificate of Non-Coverage (ECC/CNC), for development projects requiring one
Zoning certificate, for development projects requiring an ECC or CNC under City Ordinance No. 14-0011-2019, if applicable
Locational clearance under City Ordinance No. 14-0011-2019, if applicable
Duly accomplished Tree Replacement Undertaking
Ocular visit or inspection, once the complete requirements are submitted

steps.client: Submit the letter of request with the complete requirements to the City Mayor's Office and give a duplicate copy to the OCENR Desk Officer. (City Mayor's Office / OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The Information Desk Officer receives and records the letter, then forwards it to the City ENRO.

steps.client: Wait for the instruction on evaluation. (OCENR, ENRO Office)
steps.agency: The City ENRO conducts an initial evaluation of the request and gives instructions to the assigned personnel.

steps.client: Wait for the inspection schedule. (OCENR Technical Office)
steps.agency: The personnel in charge evaluate the documents and schedule the date of the actual inspection.
steps.personResponsible: Project Development Officer III / Technical Personnel

steps.client: Allow inspection of the trees to be cut. (Project site)
steps.agency: Technical personnel conduct the ocular inspection to validate the request, then prepare the necessary certification for the City ENRO's signature.
steps.processingTime: 5 days (depending on the complexity of the request; the number of days may be shortened)
steps.personResponsible: Project Development Officer III / Technical Personnel

steps.client: Wait for review and approval. (OCENR, ENRO Office)
steps.agency: The City ENRO checks and reviews the Certificate of No Objection and signs it if found valid.

steps.client: Claim the Certificate of No Objection to Cut Tree. (OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The OCENR Information Desk Officer receives and records the signed certification for release to the client, to support the request for a Permit to Cut Tree with the DENR field office.

notes: Additional documents may be asked for once the submitted requirements have been fully evaluated.
Go to DENR-PENRO Albay first to ask for their guidance and their checklist. The Tree Cutting Permit itself is issued only by them.
Processing may take longer depending on how large the request is and how many clients reach the office at the same time.

services.title: Requesting free tree seedlings
services.description: Free seedlings from the city nursery for schools, organizations, businesses and other groups running tree growing activities. The office produces and distributes them to support community greening.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources (OCENR)

requirements.item: Letter of request addressed to the City Mayor, attention the City ENRO, giving the contact details of the focal person such as mobile number and email address
Promissory of Undertaking setting out the conditions the client has to comply with

steps.client: Submit the letter of request, the original copy to the City Mayor's Office and the duplicate to the OCENR Desk Officer. (City Mayor's Office / OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The Desk Officer receives and records the request and forwards it to the City ENRO.
The City ENRO evaluates the request and checks seedling availability.
Technical staff prepare a Promissory of Undertaking for the client to sign.
steps.personResponsible: Supervising Environmental Management Specialist / Technical Personnel

steps.client: Submit the signed Promissory of Undertaking to the OCENR Desk Information Officer. (OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The OCENR Desk Information Officer releases the Seedling Withdrawal Slip, signed by the City ENRO, to the client. If the application is ineligible or seedlings are unavailable, the applicant is given proper documentation of the findings.
steps.processingTime: ½ Day, or depending on the availability of the client

steps.client: Present the Seedling Withdrawal Slip and claim the seedlings. (OCENR Nursery)
steps.agency: Nursery personnel prepare and release the seedlings to the client.

notes: Processing may take longer depending on how complex the request is and how many clients reach the office at the same time.
verifyNotes: The charter's own total of 4 hours and 35 minutes treats the "½ Day" step as a fixed number of hours. A charter day has no stated length, so the derived total keeps it as half a day and the two figures do not match. Ask the office what half a day means here.

The charter names two officers in the person responsible column for the second and third steps. Their names are moved to Office Personnel and the column carries their positions, per the convention that the process table stays generic.

services.title: Having a septic tank desludged
services.description: Desludging or syphoning of a septic tank by the city's vacuum truck service, under Ordinance No. 0025-2015, the Septage Management Code of the City of Legazpi. The code covers every proposed, planned or existing building or structure in the city, public or private, residential or commercial.
services.office: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources (OCENR)

requirements.item: Letter of request

steps.client: Walk in to the OCENR Information Desk. (OCENR Front Desk)
steps.agency: The Desk Officer refers the client to the technical personnel in charge of the Septage Program.

steps.client: Answer the survey questions. (OCENR Office)
steps.agency: Personnel interview the client and fill out the Survey Form.

steps.client: Confirm the details. (OCENR Office)
steps.agency: The Coordinator schedules the inspection of the septic tank, provided the survey form is completely filled out.

steps.client: Wait for the inspection. (Client's site)
steps.agency: Personnel inspect the septic tank.

steps.client: Pay the septage desludging fee. (City Treasurer's Office or City Engineer's Office)

The client pays the septage fee at the City Treasurer's Office or the City Engineer's Office and presents the official receipt to OCENR.

steps.client: Wait for the desludging team. (Client's site)

steps.client: Sign the manifest form. (Client's site)
steps.agency: The Coordinator prepares the Manifest Form for the client's signature to confirm completion.
